result.instructions: Tools for Chatwoot, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which conversations are open and not assigned to anyone right now?"; "Show the messages in the conversation with the customer who wrote about billing."; "Assign conversation 1234 to the support team.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Chatwoot data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run chatwoot_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run chatwoot_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run chatwoot_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. chatwoot_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: chatwoot_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the configured Chatwoot account: name, locale, features and plan. Chatwoot API: GET /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}.

tools.name: chatwoot_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List conversations, 25 per page, filtered by status, assignee, inbox, team, labels or a text query. Chatwoot API: GET /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/conversations.

labels.description: Only conversations with all these label titles.

tools.name: chatwoot_get_conversation_counts
tools.title: Get conversation counts
tools.description: Get the open, unassigned and total conversation counts for a status, inbox or team. Chatwoot API: GET /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/conversations/meta.

tools.name: chatwoot_get_conversation
tools.title: Get conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation with its status, priority, assignee, team, labels and contact. Chatwoot API: GET .../conversations/{conversation_id}.

tools.name: chatwoot_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List the messages of one conversation, oldest first. Chatwoot API: GET .../conversations/{conversation_id}/messages.

before.description: Only messages with an id below this value.

after.description: Only messages with an id above this value.

tools.name: chatwoot_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List resolved contacts (those with an email, phone number or identifier), 15 per page. Chatwoot API: GET .../contacts.

tools.name: chatwoot_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search resolved contacts by a text key (name, email or phone). Chatwoot API: GET .../contacts/search.

tools.name: chatwoot_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one contact with its attributes, labels and custom attributes. Chatwoot API: GET .../contacts/{id}.

tools.name: chatwoot_list_contact_conversations
tools.title: List contact conversations
tools.description: List all conversations of one contact. Chatwoot API: GET .../contacts/{id}/conversations.

tools.name: chatwoot_list_labels
tools.title: List labels
tools.description: List all labels of the account. Chatwoot API: GET .../labels.

tools.name: chatwoot_list_inboxes
tools.title: List inboxes
tools.description: List the inboxes (channels) of the account. Chatwoot API: GET .../inboxes.

tools.name: chatwoot_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List the agents of the account with their roles. Chatwoot API: GET .../agents.

tools.name: chatwoot_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams of the account. Chatwoot API: GET .../teams.

tools.name: chatwoot_list_canned_responses
tools.title: List canned responses
tools.description: List the saved reply templates (canned responses) of the account. Chatwoot API: GET .../canned_responses.

tools.name: chatwoot_send_message
tools.title: Send message or private note
tools.description: Add a message to a conversation. Default: a private note that the customer never sees. Set private to false to send a reply that the customer receives by email or chat. Chatwoot API: POST .../conversations/{conversation_id}/messages.

private.description: true (default) = internal note; false = customer-visible reply.

tools.name: chatwoot_set_conversation_status
tools.title: Set conversation status
tools.description: Set a conversation to open, resolved, pending or snoozed. For snoozed, snoozed_until is a Unix time in seconds (optional). Chatwoot API: POST .../conversations/{conversation_id}/toggle_status.

snoozed_until.description: Unix time in seconds; only with status snoozed.

tools.name: chatwoot_set_conversation_priority
tools.title: Set conversation priority
tools.description: Set a conversation priority: urgent, high, medium, low, or none (clears it). Chatwoot API: PATCH .../conversations/{conversation_id}.

tools.name: chatwoot_assign_conversation
tools.title: Assign conversation
tools.description: Assign a conversation to an agent (assignee_id) or to a team (team_id). Give exactly one. Chatwoot API: POST .../conversations/{conversation_id}/assignments.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Chatwoot
prompts.description: What you can do with Chatwoot here, with example requests to try.
